architecture.summary: SO-09 adds the tenant fleet operations: the weekly organization sweep and the daily fleet summary in the hosted control plane, and the operator fleet script (script/fleet/, a new operator CLI container outside src) that lists, requests, upgrades, suspends, resumes, deletes, and summarizes tenants. TenantPlatform gains five operations with closed result unions (deployImage, suspendService, resumeService, memoryUse, restartCount); the new public contract OrganizationInventory of tenants is implemented by workos, a new type-only edge workos -> tenants, and the rules forbid tenants -> workos. In the server only the sweeps use the new parts: delete, memoryUse, and restartCount, the fleet read, and the deleted mark; deploy, suspend, resume, their marks, the digest record, and the revive have callers only in the fleet script. The sweep deletes a tenant only when the complete WorkOS list leaves the organization out and the read by ID answers 404; a failed page deletes nothing, creating and deploying rows wait, and each registry write names the state that it starts from. New external use: Render deploy by image digest, suspend, resume, memory metrics, and service events; WorkOS organization list, read by ID, and memberships. New contracts: the log lines Tenant fleet summary, Organization sweep, Tenant removal record and failed, which the SO-11 monitors read, and the setting TENANT_SWEEP_HOUR_UTC, read only with MCP_TENANTS_ENABLED=true. The sweeps share the SQL runtime slots and the Render limits with the provisioner. Five registry views change: Context, C4 containers hosted (operator CLI container), the tenant registry view (WorkOS adapter, new calls), the collaboration overview, and the new weekly organization sweep scenario. The rules file declares the edge, the public module, and the forbidden edge; the test gate policy adds the new suites; no package, migration, or deployment unit changes.
